schema.name: school
schema.description: A small learning platform: students enroll in courses, courses publish assignments, students submit work that gets graded.

tables.name: students
tables.description: One row per learner. Cohort groups students by intake term.
columns: Date the student joined the platform.

tables.name: courses
tables.description: Catalog of courses. A course may have no assignments yet.

tables.name: enrollments
tables.description: Bridge table: which student is in which course, and their status.

tables.name: assignments
tables.description: Gradable work. course_id is NULL for items still in the shared assignment bank.
columns: Owning course; NULL while unattached in the bank.
Due date; NULL for bank items.

tables.name: submissions
tables.description: One row per submitted attempt. score is NULL until graded.

fn/current_cohort.doc: Returns the intake term currently open for enrollment.

schema.name: firm
schema.description: A consulting firm: employees log hours against client projects. Projects are booked to a July–June fiscal year; tax returns use the calendar year.

tables.name: employees
tables.description: One row per person. home_country is where they are based, not where they worked.
columns: ISO country code of the home office.

tables.name: projects
tables.description: Client engagements. fiscal_year names the fiscal year (July 1 to June 30) the project is booked to, named for the year it ends.
columns: Company fiscal year, July–June, named for the year it ends. FY2025 = 2024-07-01 to 2025-06-30.

tables.name: work_logs
tables.description: One row per day of logged work. work_country is where the work was physically performed.
columns: Project the hours are billed to.
ISO country code where the work was physically performed.

notes.notes/us-hours: Total hours physically worked inside the United States, by every employee, wherever they are based.
notes.rules/tax-year: A tax-year question must bind $tax_year. Filter on the calendar year of work_logs.worked_on, never on projects.fiscal_year.
notes.env/fiscal-vs-tax: Projects are booked to a July–June fiscal year. A FY2025 project has hours in calendar 2024 and 2025. Ask which tax year the return is for; do not infer it from the project.

fleet.demo.title: Fleet
fleet.demo.description: Ship sensor readings and routing notes.

notes.notes/water-temp: Sea-surface water temperature reported by the hull sensor.
notes.rules/water-temp: Degrees Fahrenheit, whole number, truncated toward zero. Sensor range 24–95 °F.
notes.notes/freezing-point: The temperature at which seawater starts to freeze. It depends on salinity.
notes.env/sea-route: The freezing point depends on the sea. Atlantic water (about 35 PSU) freezes near 28.6 °F; Baltic surface water (about 7 PSU) freezes near 31.3 °F. Bind $freezing_point from the route, never from a default.

notes.notes/implicit-mul: In written math, 2x is shorthand for 2 × x. The tree always stores the multiplication explicitly.
notes.rules/implicit-mul: Normalization rule: a number written directly before a variable means mul(number, variable). Both written forms map to the same tree.
notes.notes/equation: A linear equation in one unknown, x. It holds when x = 3.

hello.doc: Greets whatever you pass in do.

client.demo.title: Client file
client.demo.description: A client CSV of work hours, loaded with registerCSV.

tables.name: client_hours
tables.description: Loaded from CSV (22 rows). row_id numbers the rows in file order.
columns: Row number in the file, 1 to n.

notes.rules/tax-year: Before submitting, the user must state the tax year they are referencing.

queries.title: Students in a cohort
queries.intent: Show me everyone in the fall 2026 cohort.
queries.ref: SELECT * FROM students WHERE cohort = '2026-fall'

queries.title: Top students by GPA
queries.intent: Who are the top 5 students with at least a 3.5 GPA?
queries.ref: SELECT first_name, last_name, gpa FROM students WHERE gpa >= 3.5 ORDER BY gpa DESC LIMIT 5

queries.title: Students who joined in a date window
queries.intent: Who joined the platform during August 2026?
queries.ref: SELECT student_id, email, enrolled_on FROM students WHERE enrolled_on BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-01' AND DATE '2026-08-31' ORDER BY enrolled_on ASC

queries.title: Ungraded work since a date
queries.intent: What has been submitted since September 15 that still has no grade?
queries.ref: SELECT * FROM submissions WHERE submitted_at >= DATE '2026-09-15' AND score IS NULL

queries.title: Average score per assignment
queries.intent: For assignments with at least 3 submissions, what is the average score?
queries.ref: SELECT assignment_id, round(avg(score), 1) AS avg_score, count(*) AS n FROM submissions GROUP BY assignment_id HAVING count(*) >= 3 ORDER BY avg_score DESC

queries.title: Late or resubmitted work scoring low
queries.intent: Which late or resubmitted submissions scored under 70?
queries.ref: SELECT submission_id, student_id, score, status FROM submissions WHERE status IN ('late', 'resubmitted') AND score < 70

queries.title: Course roster (inner join)
queries.intent: Who is enrolled in CS101?
queries.ref: SELECT students.first_name, students.last_name, courses.title FROM students INNER JOIN enrollments ON enrollments.student_id = students.student_id INNER JOIN courses ON courses.course_id = enrollments.course_id WHERE courses.code = 'CS101'

queries.title: Students with no submissions (left join)
queries.intent: Which students have never submitted anything?
queries.ref: SELECT students.student_id, students.email FROM students LEFT JOIN submissions ON submissions.student_id = students.student_id WHERE submissions.submission_id IS NULL

queries.title: Courses and assignments without a partner (full outer join)
queries.intent: Which courses have no assignments, and which assignments belong to no course?
queries.ref: SELECT courses.code, assignments.title FROM courses FULL OUTER JOIN assignments ON assignments.course_id = courses.course_id WHERE courses.course_id IS NULL OR assignments.assignment_id IS NULL

queries.title: Active enrollment by department
queries.intent: How many active enrollments does each department have?
queries.ref: SELECT courses.department, count(enrollments.enrollment_id) AS enrolled FROM courses LEFT JOIN enrollments ON enrollments.course_id = courses.course_id AND enrollments.status = 'active' GROUP BY courses.department ORDER BY enrolled DESC, courses.department ASC

queries.title: Hello, world (call)
queries.intent: Call the hello handler with do=world.

queries.title: Cohort bound by a call
queries.intent: Show me everyone in the cohort that is open for enrollment right now.
queries.ref: SELECT * FROM students WHERE cohort = '2026-fall'

queries.title: US hours: calendar year vs fiscal year
queries.intent: How do US hours split between calendar years and project fiscal years?
queries.ref: SELECT extract(year from work_logs.worked_on) AS calendar_year, projects.fiscal_year, sum(work_logs.hours) AS us_hours FROM work_logs INNER JOIN projects ON projects.project_id = work_logs.project_id WHERE work_logs.work_country = 'US' GROUP BY extract(year from work_logs.worked_on), projects.fiscal_year ORDER BY calendar_year ASC, projects.fiscal_year ASC

-- Tables loaded from CSV files.

CREATE TABLE client_hours (
  row_id       integer PRIMARY KEY,
  employee     text,
  date         date,
  hours        numeric(6,2),
  work_country text
);
COMMENT ON TABLE client_hours IS 'Loaded from CSV (22 rows). row_id numbers the rows in file order.';
COMMENT ON COLUMN client_hours.row_id IS 'Row number in the file, 1 to n.';
COMMENT ON COLUMN client_hours.employee IS 'CSV column "employee".';
COMMENT ON COLUMN client_hours.date IS 'CSV column "date".';
COMMENT ON COLUMN client_hours.hours IS 'CSV column "hours".';
COMMENT ON COLUMN client_hours.work_country IS 'CSV column "work_country".';
